info.description: REST API in front of TeslaMate's Postgres database, the MQTT status feed, and (optionally) Tesla owner-api / TeslaMate logging command relays.
info.title: TeslaMateApi

get.description: Returns a small banner confirming the API process is running.
Banner for the /api root.
Renders the Scalar API reference UI. No auth required.
Returns 200 as long as the process is up. No auth required.
Returns the embedded OpenAPI 3.x spec. No auth required.
Returns {"message":"pong"} for simple uptime checks. No auth required.
Returns 200 when MQTT is connected (or DISABLE_MQTT=true). 503 otherwise. No auth required.
Banner for the /api/v1 root.

Returns every car TeslaMate tracks (with details / exterior / settings / stats).

Returns charging sessions with charger-shape aggregates.

Returns the allow-list. Requires ENABLE_COMMANDS=true.

post.description: Proxies to Tesla owner-api with the car's stored token. Status code and body mirror Tesla's. Requires ENABLE_COMMANDS=true.
